phrase.zh: 数月来最致命，儿童丧生

phrase.en: frames as worst toll since June truce

gloss.en: Deadly overnight strikes hit southern Lebanon, killing civilians including children.
gloss.zh: 以色列彻夜空袭黎巴嫩南部，造成包括儿童在内的平民伤亡。

why_now.en: You care about conflict and civilian toll: today the deadliest toll since the June truce shifts the regional tension.
why_now.zh: 你关注冲突与平民伤亡，今日自六月休战以来最严重伤亡改变地区紧张局势。

phrase.en: frames as strongest in decades, 47 dead
frames as rescue operations under way
frames as thousands seeking higher ground

gloss.en: A 7.7-magnitude quake struck Flores, killing dozens and prompting tsunami fear.
gloss.zh: 弗洛勒斯岛发生7.7级地震，数十人遇难，引发海啸恐慌。

why_now.en: You follow global disasters as they unfold: this morning's powerful quake is one of the strongest in decades.
why_now.zh: 你关注全球灾害动态：今晨强震为数十年来最强之一。

phrase.en: frames as meaningful transparency reduces persuasion
phrase.zh: 有意义透明度降低说服力

phrase.en: frames as design for trust in AI systems

gloss.en: New research shows disclosing AI's persuasive intent reduces its influence on users.
gloss.zh: 新研究显示，披露AI的说服意图会降低其对用户的影响力。

why_now.en: You work on HCI and critical visualization: this finding directly touches your interest in how interface transparency shapes user trust.
why_now.zh: 你研究人机交互与批判可视化：这一发现直接影响你对界面透明度如何塑造用户信任的兴趣。

phrase.en: frames as AI training causing book pulping
frames as LLM-native recommendation at Netflix

gloss.en: AI's thirst for data and energy contrasts with physical limitations, raising sustainability debates.
gloss.zh: AI对数据和能源的渴望与物理限制形成对比，引发可持续性辩论。

why_now.en: Your interest in technical communication intersects: the environmental cost of AI is now a public conversation.
why_now.zh: 你对技术传播的兴趣交叉：AI的环境成本如今成为公开讨论。
